newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT-EPS upside for Orbotech.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-EPS upside for Orbotech.

text.p: Israel's Orbotech Ltd, a maker of printed circuit board (PCB) inspection equipment and related products, could exceed Lehman Brothers' second-quarter earnings estimates, the brokerage said in a report released on Thursday.

"We believe the company stands a good chance of beating our second-quarter EPS (earnings per share) estimate of $0.49 (up 29 percent). Indeed, we could easily see EPS in the $0.52-0.53 range," analyst Ted Kundtz said.
Kundtz said he would consider revising second-half EPS upward after Orbotech reports on the secOnd quarter on August 4.
"Orbotech has good visibility in both the PCB and flat panel display (FPD) markets through 1997, which augurs well for upward revisions in our second-half EPS estimates," he said.
Lehman said the PCB market would grow as much as 10-15 percent this year, up from earlier estimates of seven to 10 percent, which could translate into stronger sales for Orbotech.
"Combined with the strong momentum of the FDP market and the expected growing contribution from new products...we believe there is upside to our 1998 EPS estimate as well," Kundtz said.
Lehman is currently forecasting 1997 full-year EPS of $1.99 and 1998 EPS at $2.35. Kundtz said he was retaining his buy recommendation.
